whatItDoes: The handoff command turns useful conversation context into an editable prompt and opens a linked fresh session.
It carries selected context and an explicit goal, not live process state or a complete transcript.

whenToReachForIt.invocation: Type /handoff followed by the next session goal.

situations.when: A long session needs a clean continuation
situations.use: Draft a focused brief for a linked replacement session.

situations.when: A new model or context window should continue the work
situations.use: Carry retained context and the next goal across the boundary.

whatItAdds: An explicit, editable context-transfer step between Pi sessions.
A linked replacement-session flow after the draft is accepted.

howItFits.relationship: The communication prompt can tighten a handoff goal before transfer.
Subagents keep bounded work inside one run; handoff moves selected context into a fresh session.

questions.question: What should I review before continuing?
answer: Handoff is model-generated and intentionally selective, so review the draft; it does not transfer live process state, and it sends selected conversation context to the configured model.

workingIf: An editable draft appears before session replacement.
The linked fresh session opens with enough context to act on the stated goal.
setupNotes: Adopted from the MIT-licensed Pi example originally implemented by Mario Zechner; maintained here by Vedang.
The installed source is the local handoff extension in Dotagents.
It requires an interactive Pi session, a selected model with credentials, and replacement-session UI support.
